correctness.rationale: For all d>0 and k≥0 in the stated quotient convention, Denisi–Höring's equation (10) identifies the graded sections with those of the elementary transform F. Twisting Sym^k F by −C_− gives filtration quotients O(jC_+−C_−). At j=0 the fiber is O(−1), so both direct images vanish. At j≥1 the pushforward is the sum of (L*)^ℓ for 1≤ℓ≤j, with no higher direct image; elliptic Riemann–Roch and duality give h⁰=d j(j+1)/2 and no higher cohomology. Thus sections of the twisted symmetric power have dimension d binom(k+2,3), and H¹=0 makes restriction onto the one-dimensional Sym^k of the Serre bundle surjective. This includes k=0. The series follows formally, volume is 3! times the cubic leading coefficient, and the quotient-projective-bundle relation gives ξ³=c₁(T_M)²−c₂(T_M)=0 by the ruled-surface Chern numbers. Non-finite generation is the cited theorem, not a consequence of the series. The frozen VERIFY.py was inspected, not executed; it checks finite numerical identities only, and its final normalization assertion actually uses floating-point division.
